run_pybullet_sphere_simulation: run a pybullet GUI simulation that spawns a grid of spheres and boxes in a monastery environment
create_collision_shape_mesh: create a concave trimesh collision shape from an OBJ file using pybullet GEOM_MESH
create_multibody_grid: create a 5x5x5 grid of multi-body spheres and boxes with alternating collision shapes
change_dynamics_friction: change dynamics properties like spinning friction, rolling friction, and linear damping on a multi-body
set_gravity_simulation: set gravity and enable real-time simulation in a pybullet physics environment
